initialization: Corrected SDK camera poses; no SDK residual/prior
trajectory: One camera knot per image; LiDAR scan residual interpolates adjacent knots, linear center + normalized quaternion interpolation
lidar: Existing per-point SDK-odometry deskew; up to~300 sampled points/scan, range.3..12m, initial plane gate5cm, plane support>=3scans, sigma3cm; plane n/d jointly optimized
visual: Existing COLMAP matches; SDK-depth/triangulation tracks with1deg seed selection, recover all observations within4px, >=4 distinct views, no plane requirement, Huber2px
refine: Fixed structure; >=4views with <=3px residual, median<=1.5px, parallax>=1deg if LiDAR-supported else2deg; per-camera >=12obs in>=6cells of8x6; Huber1.5px
gauge: First pose fixed; LiDAR measurements determine metric scale
camera: Original FishPoly rectified K406.8 with+0.5 COLMAP center conversion; output later used with common K550 training images
